label: Elam

text.BHSA NEH 10:14: רָאשֵׁ֖י הָעָ֑ם פַּרְעֹשׁ֙ פַּחַ֣ת מֹואָ֔ב עֵילָ֥ם זַתּ֖וּא בָּנִֽי׃
text.KJV NEH 10:14: The chief of the people; Parosh, Pahathmoab, Elam, Zatthu, Bani,

A.name: Elam
A.line: his sons (descendants) returned to Judah after captivity (EZR 2:7)
A.notes: father of Jehiel (EZR 10:2), named on the sealed document of NEH 10:1-27 (NEH 10:14)
family: ancestor-of jeshaiah-3 (Jeshaiah, descendant of Elam, son of Athaliah who went up with Ezra (E)
descendant-of jacob (Jacob, second-born son of Isaac (GEN 25:25-26))

B.name: Elam
B.line: Chief of the people who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah

why: The Hebrew introduces this list as רָאשֵׁי הָעָם, “chiefs of the people,” matching B’s stated role as a covenant signer. A is described primarily as the ancestor of a returning family, though the absence of a patronymic leaves some uncertainty about whether the list uses ancestral family names.
